# Recursive_Metric_Contraction

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of repeatedly applying a contraction operator to a metric space, reducing inter-point distances while preserving topological invariants, to generate multi-scale representations. Enables scalable hierarchical data structuring in TCC, allowing efficient storage and retrieval of topological features across learning episodes.
